description: Seal-2 Route E state-preserving prototype bypass
hypothesis: A single previously decoded page can supply multiple separated exact WRT spans whose complete prototype and command cost is smaller than their actual endpoint428 arithmetic payload, while replaying copied bits preserves the parent model trajectory.

mechanism.copy_operation: omit exact prior-page WRT span from arithmetic truth stream while preserving parent updates
mechanism.selection: exact integer-qbit dynamic program over frozen longest-match candidates

interfaces_exposed: BYPASS_COPY reconstructs prior WRT bytes without arithmetic truth decisions while feeding them through the unchanged parent update path
retired_neighborhoods: independent exact-copy position lists and page-delta serializations that alter or reset the mature backend trajectory

promotion_gate: Exact opening-1M E2 must save at least 3000 B/M gross, at least 2100 B/M after source allowance, beat E1 and ER, remain positive on selection and confirmation, and pass every identity check.
kill_gate: Retire unchanged single-prototype Route E on any gate miss without minimum-length, code, distance-window, or prototype-count sweeps.
